greeting.de: Dein Projects-Portfolio ist bereit — Repos als Karten oder Tabelle, KPIs oben, Runs aus dem Detail-Panel.
greeting.en: Your projects portfolio is ready — repos as cards or a table, KPIs on top, runs from the detail panel.

agent_prompt.de: Onboarding für kind projects. Zuerst dashboard.read (Layout + data). Daten: projects.import_github (github_pat), projects.add_rows, projects.link_workspace. Felder in projects[]: title, remote_url, tags, status, security, pinned. Layout: dashboard.patch_layout — hero/stat/card_grid/section/table; card_grid und table teilen dataPath projects. KPI stat_* synchronisieren sich automatisch bei Änderungen an projects[] (add_rows, import, link, patch_data). Run-Now über Karte/Zeile im UI (enableRunNow). Kein Schema installieren.
agent_prompt.en: Onboarding for kind projects. Start with dashboard.read (layout + data). Data: projects.import_github (github_pat), projects.add_rows, projects.link_workspace. Row fields: title, remote_url, tags, status, security, pinned. Layout: dashboard.patch_layout — hero/stat/card_grid/section/table; card_grid and table share dataPath projects. KPI stat_* blocks auto-sync when projects[] changes (add_rows, import, link, patch_data). Run now from card/row detail in UI (enableRunNow). Do not install schema.

de: Zeig meine Projekte als Karten-Grid mit Status und Security-Badges.
en: Show my projects as a card grid with status and security badges.
